summary: Section C covers all rubric-required elements (clamp validation, assay non-harmonisation, biological variability, index comparison table) with high citation fidelity — all key numerical claims (Bonora r=−0.820, n=115, κ=0.63; Marcovina CV 12–66% across 12 assays with des(64,65) proinsulin cross-reactivity >40% in 9/10; Manley 2007 factor-of-2 variation across 11 assays in 150 samples; Manley 2008 HOMA-IR 0.8–2.0 vs 1.5–2.9, 15% plasma effect; Jayagopal >90%/>47% RCV) verified against PubMed abstracts and match the section text exactly. Type tags are consistently applied with no bare citations; population descriptors are present for each study; the r²≈0.67 derivation is mathematically correct; and Marcovina's workgroup report is appropriately tagged mechanism_review given the absence of a specific analytical-methods tag in the enum.
